name: web-chat-bubbles-component-with-avatars-on-dotted-white
title: Chat component with a black outgoing bubble and a grey incoming bubble, each with a round avatar, on a dotted ground
whatItIs: A dotted white frame with two chat bubbles: a black bubble 'I have a question about the library.' with a photo avatar at the right and a light grey reply 'Sure, I'd be happy to help!' with an avatar at the left.
whatItMeans: Simple and clear; black versus grey shows who is speaking.
techniques: Use black for the user and grey for the reply.

vocabulary.definition: A message from the user, often dark.
A faint dot grid as background.
